insurer_name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
residency_requirement: Indian resident with optional global treatment cover (specific variants); for claims outside India, network providers via Service Provider
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 36 months; specific disease 24 months; maternity (where included) typically 24 months

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road and Air ambulance per plan limits

maternity_coverage.notes: Available on higher Premia plans with 24-month waiting; includes lawful MTP expenses

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Critical illness benefit per Section 4.2 definitions

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Refill benefit up to Base Sum Insured for unrelated illness

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Annual health checkup with extensive panel

room_rent_capping: No cap on Direct/Aspire/Platinum plans (Silver may have eligibility band)

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: International cover available via Service Provider network for planned and emergency hospitalisation on select plans

notable_exclusions_summary: Premium product with international cover, maternity (on higher plans), critical illness, refill, and large SI options up to Rs 3 Cr. No room rent cap on top plans.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via Niva Bupa network and global Service Provider. 30-minute cashless turnaround target. Reimbursement via app for non-network providers within 48 hours of admission.
